# nanoflags_flag (Data Source)

Reads a flag's details (archived flags included). Scope: `flags:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nanoflags_flag" "checkout" {
  project = "web"
  key     = "new-checkout"
}

output "checkout_flag_type" {
  value = data.nanoflags_flag.checkout.type
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Flag key.
- `project` (String) Project key or id.

### Read-Only

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the flag is archived.
- `archived_at` (String) Archive time.
- `client_exposed` (Boolean) Served to browser and mobile keys.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `id` (String) Flag id (UUID).
- `initial_value` (String) JSON-encoded initial value.
- `json_schema` (String) JSON-encoded JSON Schema of a json flag.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `owner_id` (String) Owner member id.
- `permanent` (Boolean) Meant to stay in code.
- `purpose` (String) `release`, `experiment`, `operational` or `permission`.
- `review_date` (String) Review date.
- `type` (String) `boolean`, `string`, `number` or `json`.
